entries.effect: the object that drives a document browser transition, carrying where it is going and how far the load has got, and honouring the transitioning protocol it declares: transitionDuration: is the port's own time for a document that has arrived and zero while it is still coming across, and animateTransition: is a plain cross-dissolve of the view it was aimed at, completing even when there is none. What a real document browser's transition looks like is Apple's and is not measured here, because neither this host nor this release has a Files app or a document provider
